I replied to Ilse in a thread on their message in #north-team. The reply says I've noted that they're on the road tomorrow morning (Thu 15 Oct) and reachable on mobile.

Ilse has nothing on their calendar for tomorrow, so no meetings need to move. I offered to add an "on the road" block to their calendar or pass messages on while they're away. I didn't do either, because they didn't ask for it.
